[USER] User stated they need to transform the data using a Power BI DAX formula.

[USER] User provided an example format for the transformation:  
[FACT] O-22-056-ART12-PI4-K02

[USER] User noted that some formulas have a wrong format, such as:  
[FACT] O-22-082-ART13-PI3-K011, which should be O-22-082-ART13-PI3-K11  
[FACT] O-22-073-ART4-PI4-K01, which should be O-22-073-ART04-PI4-K01.  
[USER] User asked how to transform the column using Power BI DAX logic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a DAX formula to transform the column.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] DAX Formula:  
```less
New Column = 
IF(
    LEN(Table1[Column]) = 22,     
    Table1[Column],               
    CONCATENATE(                  
        LEFT(Table1[Column], 7),  
        IF(
            LEN(Table1[Column]) = 24,      
            CONCATENATE("ART", MID(Table1[Column], 11, 2)),   
            CONCATENATE("ART0", MID(Table1[Column], 11, 1))  
        ),
        MID(Table1[Column], 14, 6)    
    )
)
```  
[USER] User pointed out that the formula creates a syntax error and noted that CONCATENATE() seems to only take two arguments.
